checks.title: Each step that uses actions/setup-go declares a runtime that GitHub Actions supports
checks.rationale: go.yml (PR CI build job) runs actions/setup-go@v4, which declares the node16 runtime. GitHub removed node16 from runners and forces such actions onto a newer Node.js, and actionlint 1.7.7 reports the step as too old to run. setup-go v6 declares node24. The check runs actionlint on the worktree and keeps only the runtime findings for the updated action.

checks.title: setup-go v6 toolchain selection reads the same go directive as v4 and v5
checks.rationale: setup-go v6 (PR #460) reads the go.mod 'toolchain' directive before the 'go' directive. go.yml and dependency-scan.yml pass go-version-file: go.mod. If go.mod has no toolchain line, v6 installs the same Go version as v4 and v5. go.yml relies on this: its comment says golangci-lint breaks with a Go newer than go.mod declares.
